telusTpaProfiles._dial_phone_policy: No TPA below has a verified_provider_phone yet — that field is only ever populated after a human operator places ONE confirmation call and confirms it reaches provider claim-status support for that TPA (not just a general/member line). This is intentional: TELUS's own FAQ (plus.telushealth.co/page/eclaims/help/FAQ/AdjudiCare.htm, confirmed 2026-08-01) states 'TELUS AdjudiCare is aggregated... please contact your insurer directly' — there is no single AdjudiCare line, and dialing the wrong TPA's number burns one of only 3 allowed call attempts. As of 2026-08-01, 10 of 13 TPAs below have a TELUS_OFFICIAL research_lead — sourced from TELUS Health's own per-insurer eClaims contact page (plus.telushealth.co/page/eclaims/help/FAQ/<Insurer>.htm), which is TELUS telling its own registered providers exactly who to call. This is the strongest source available short of an actual test call, and in several cases (Alberta Blue Cross, Pacific Blue Cross, GroupHEALTH, Johnston Group, Beneva/SSQ) it corrected numbers that an older third-party directory (CDHA Carrier Contacts PDF, dated 2018) or the insurer's own general-public site had wrong or outdated for this purpose. Two TPAs (Benecaid, Empire Life) are not on TELUS's eClaims participating-insurer list at all — that's a separate open question, not just an unverified number; the group_prefix_ranges mapping for those two letters may itself be stale. Until an operator confirms a number, getTelusDialPhone() returns null and dispatch escalates to a human rather than guess-dialing — see queueEngine.ts.

Alberta Blue Cross.note: Supersedes earlier candidates from ab.bluecross.ca's general contact page (1-800-661-6995) and the 2018 CDHA PDF — both were for the wrong department.

candidates: 1-877-797-7448 (CDHA Carrier Contacts PDF, dated 2018 — unconfirmed, Benecaid does not appear in TELUS's current eClaims participating-insurer list)
Benecaid.note: Open question whether the 'B' group prefix still maps to Benecaid at all under current TELUS AdjudiCare routing — needs a human to check, not just a phone number to verify.

ClaimSecure.note: Matches the 2018 CDHA PDF and claimsecure.com's own site — triple-confirmed.

candidates: 1-800-267-0215 (CDHA Carrier Contacts PDF, dated 2018 — unconfirmed, Empire Life does not appear in TELUS's current eClaims participating-insurer list)
Empire Life.note: Same open question as Benecaid — verify the 'E' prefix mapping itself, not just this number.

GroupHEALTH.note: The 2018 CDHA PDF's 1-877-542-4110 was filed under 'Manion Wilkins' — Manion is actually a separate TPA in TELUS's own list, not the same as GroupHEALTH. Do not conflate them.

Johnston Group.note: The 2018 CDHA PDF's number for 'Johnston Group' (1-800-893-7587) is actually TELUS's current number for Maximum Benefit — the two were mismatched in that old source.

Industrial Alliance.note: Matches the 2018 CDHA PDF and an independent broker site — triple-confirmed. Also supports CDAnet Tx23 electronic bypass for pre-visit checks (see TELUS_TPA_CONFIGS['000060'] in adapter.ts) — but Tx23 is pre-visit/predetermination only, contractually walled off from claim-status use (see cdanetClaimStatusAdapter.ts), so this phone number is still required for AR follow-up.

Pacific Blue Cross.note: Supersedes the 2018 CDHA PDF's 1-877-722-2583, which does not match.

SSQ Insurance.note: SSQ Insurance is now branded Beneva (rebranded from La Capitale in 2023; TELUS's eClaims portal shows it as 'Beneva'). Supersedes beneva.ca's own general line (1-800-463-6262) and the old SSQ number (1-888-651-8181) — neither matched TELUS's eClaims-specific contact.
